description: Additional APIs for test support in GeckoView.

functions.name: setPrefs
functions.description: Set prefs and return a set of saved prefs

functions.name: restorePrefs
functions.description: Restore prefs to old value

functions.name: getPrefs
functions.description: Get pref values.

functions.name: clearUserPref
functions.description: Clears the user pref.

functions.name: getLinkColor
functions.description: Get resolved color for the link resolved by a given selector.

functions.name: isVideoCloning
functions.description: Whether the video resolved by a given selector is being cloned visually into another video element.

functions.name: getVideoStatusMessage
functions.description: The message the video controls overlay shows over the video resolved by a given selector, or null if it shows none.

functions.name: getRequestedLocales
functions.description: Gets the requested locales.

functions.name: addHistogram
functions.description: Add a sample with the given value to the histogram with the given id.

functions.name: removeAllCertOverrides
functions.description: Revokes SSL certificate overrides.

functions.name: setResolutionAndScaleTo
functions.description: Invokes nsIDOMWindowUtils.setResolutionAndScaleTo.

functions.name: getActive
functions.description: Returns true if the docShell is active for given tab.

functions.name: getPidForTab
functions.description: Gets the top-level pid belonging to tabId.

functions.name: getBrowsingContextGroupIdForTab
functions.description: Gets the id of the browsing context group belonging to tabId.

functions.name: getRemoteTypeForTab
functions.description: Gets the remote type of the content process belonging to tabId.

functions.name: mintPictureInPicturePlacementToken
functions.description: Mints a picture-in-picture placement token standing for the browsing context group and content process of tabId, as a picture-in-picture request would.

functions.name: waitForContentTransformsReceived
functions.description: If we want to test screen coordinates, we need to wait for the updated data which is what this function allows us to do

functions.name: getAllBrowserPids
functions.description: Gets the list of pids of the running browser processes

functions.name: getProfilePath
functions.description: Gets the path of the current profile

functions.name: killContentProcess
functions.description: Crash all content processes

functions.name: flushApzRepaints
functions.description: Invokes nsIDOMWindowUtils.flushApzRepaints for the document of the tabId.

functions.name: zoomToFocusedInput
functions.description: Invokes nsIDOMWindowUtils.zoomToFocusedInput for the document of the tabId.

functions.name: promiseAllPaintsDone
functions.description: A simplified version of promiseAllPaintsDone in paint_listeners.js.

functions.name: usingGpuProcess
functions.description: Returns true if Gecko is using a GPU process.

functions.name: killGpuProcess
functions.description: Kills the GPU process cleanly without generating a crash report.

functions.name: crashGpuProcess
functions.description: Causes the GPU process to crash.

functions.name: clearHSTSState
functions.description: Clears the sites on the HSTS list.

functions.name: isFissionRunning
functions.description: Checks if fission is running.

functions.name: triggerTranslationsOffer
functions.description: Simulates offering a translation.

functions.name: triggerLanguageStateChange
functions.description: Simulates expecting a translation.

functions.name: setHandlingUserInput
functions.description: Invokes nsIDOMWindowUtils.setHandlingUserInput to simulate user input activation.

functions.name: getWebExtensionsSchemaPermissionNames
functions.description: Returns all the permission names defined in the WebExtensions API JSONSchema given an array of type names

functions.name: teardownAlertsService
functions.description: Triggers teardown on Alerts Service so that it can clear all notification information.

functions.name: showPicker
functions.description: Calls showPicker() on the element matching the selector, with a simulated user gesture activation in the same turn.

functions.name: saveTrackingDBEvents
functions.description: Seeds the tracking protection database with the given JSON-serialized content blocking log.

functions.name: clearTrackingDB
functions.description: Removes all entries from the tracking protection database.

functions.name: addVirtualAuthenticator
functions.description: Adds a virtual WebAuthn authenticator via nsIWebAuthnService.

functions.name: removeVirtualAuthenticator
functions.description: Removes a virtual WebAuthn authenticator via nsIWebAuthnService.

functions.name: setupIPPAuthProvider
functions.description: Seeds the IP protection test auth provider with a faked Guardian backend.

functions.name: simulateIPPSignIn
functions.description: Toggles the IP protection test auth provider's sign-in state.

functions.name: setIPPProxyPassError
functions.description: Makes the IP protection test auth provider's fetchProxyPass throw the given error.

functions.name: setIPPProxyUsage
functions.description: Sets what the IP protection test auth provider's fetchProxyUsage resolves to.

functions.name: getIPPProxyInfo
functions.description: Returns the active IP protection proxy connection's proxyInfo (host, port, type), or null when no connection is active.
